segments.ja310:1.3: Na icche saha nindāya, evaṃ seyya [sayha (sī. syā. pī.)] vijānahi.
segments.ja310:3.3: Sāyeva jīvikā seyyo, yā cādhammena esanā.
segments.ja310:4.3: Aññaṃ ahiṃsayaṃ loke, api rajjena taṃ varanti.
segments.ja310:7.1: Vivarañca adeyya samiddhavaraṃ, atha daddara pāpamahātiraho;
segments.ja310:7.3: Atha koli palāsavarañca kara, carimaṃ sasamuddavarena dasāti.
